description: Control-plane window. Grants core:default, which is wider than what the frontend uses: it only needs core:event (listen) — app commands are not ACL-gated, and getCurrentWebviewWindow().label is a local property read with no IPC. Narrowing this needs one manual run on Windows to confirm nothing in Tauri's own window plumbing regresses, so it is left as-is rather than tightened blind. See issue #21.
